entries.category_description: Supply of electricity, district heating and district cooling, and biogas produced by the feedstock listed in Annex IX, Part A, to Directive (EU) 2018/2001 of the European Parliament and of the Council; supply and installation of highly efficient low emissions heating systems meeting the emission (PM) benchmarks laid down in Annex V to Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/1189 and in Annex V to Commission Regulation (EU) 2015/1185 and having been attributed an EU energy label to show that the criterion referred to in Article 7(2) of Regulation (EU) 2017/1369 of the European Parliament and of the Council is met; and, until 1 January 2030, natural gas and wood used as firewood
entries.code_description: Steam and hot water supply services through mains
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N0 20, Table A, category XIV.
The supply of electricity, heat through heating networks and natural gas used as heating fuel under residential contracts.

entries.code_description: Steam and hot water supply services through mains
entries.comment: Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XIV: the supply of heat through heating networks under residential contracts for which, with the closure of the contract in mind, a business number has not been communicated by the customer natural person

entries.code_description: Steam and hot water supply services through mains
entries.comment: Subscriptions to deliveries of heat energy distributed by networks, as well as the supply of heat when produced at least 50% from biomass, geothermal, solar thermal energy, waste and recovered energy, and delivery of chilled energy distributed by networks (article 278-0 bis B and B bis of the general tax code)

Supplies of thermal energy, if the actual consumer thereof is an inhabitant who purchases and consumes thermal energy for domestic needs. 
(Section 42, Paragraph 12 of the Law; https://likumi.lv/ta/en/en/id/253451)

entries.comment: Supply of district heating in the cold season (the 5-month period between November 1 of the current year and March 31 of the following year), intended for: the population, public and private hospitals, public and private educational institutions, non-governmental organizations, religious institutions, accredited public and private social service providers. See Art. 291 para. (2), letters k) of the Fiscal Code.
